implementation: Queue processing uses a captured item snapshot and processes items sequentially.
A successful item remains successful when a later item fails; failure is retained on that item.
Retry mode accepts only FAILED items in the selected case; pending items and other cases are excluded.
The component passes the captured item to the API adapter, avoiding a stale lookup by item id during an asynchronous batch.
